ingredientSections.heading: Dad's Juice
items: 1 Thumb-sized piece of fresh turmeric root

methodSections.heading: Dad's Juice
steps: Chop everything into small pieces for your juicer.
Juice Juice Juice! We suggest a cold-press juicer, but centrifugal juicers work well too. Feel free to email info@thejuiceryco.ca for juicer suggestions.
Strain the juice to remove any remaining fibre.
Enjoy! Remember to keep your juice refrigerated.
